visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a pair of hands pulling apart a freshly fried, golden-brown chicken wing, revealing steaming, tender white meat inside. In the blurred background, a small red bowl of dipping sauce and a slice of green lime are visible on a dark plate. (2) A male chef, wearing a black t-shirt and clear plastic gloves, is seen in a studio kitchen setting with wooden cabinets and hanging utensils. He places raw chicken wings into a large glass bowl and proceeds to add measured portions of bright yellow turmeric powder, thick white garlic and ginger pastes, and creamy yogurt. (3) The camera focuses on the chef's hands as he vigorously mixes the chicken wings with the marinade ingredients in the glass bowl, ensuring each piece is thoroughly coated in the orange-yellow mixture. He then places the bowl on a wooden tabletop as text indicates the marinating time required. (4) Transitioning to a new scene, a spoon is used to combine mayonnaise, Thai sweet chili sauce, coconut milk, and more turmeric powder in a smaller glass bowl to create a smooth, vibrant orange dipping sauce. (5) The marinated chicken wings are then tossed in a square white tray filled with fine white flour until they are completely covered. The chef briefly speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands. (6) Several coated chicken wings are carefully lowered into a deep black pot of bubbling, hot transparent oil. The camera captures the vigorous bubbling and the gradual darkening of the batter to a deep golden hue. (7) Using pink-tipped kitchen tongs, the chef removes the crispy wings from the oil and places them onto a metal cooling rack over a bowl. Finally, the wings are elegantly plated on a black dish, garnished with fresh lime wedges and small red cherry tomatoes, as the camera zooms in for a tempting final shot.
